name: KOUT BO 6
description: Kout Bo 6 (or simply Koutbo6) is a high-stakes, team-based trick-taking game popular in Egypt, Kuwait, and across the Arab world. Played by two teams of three (6 players total), it utilizes 54 cards (standard 52 + 2 Jokers). It is a game of bidding, where the winning team's contract (Hokm) dictates the trump suit, and the Red and Black Jokers serve as the most powerful permanent trumps.

content.text: Kout Bo 6 (or simply Koutbo6) is a high-stakes, team-based trick-taking game popular in Egypt, Kuwait, and across the Arab world. Played by two teams of three (6 players total), it utilizes 54 cards (standard 52 + 2 Jokers). It is a game of bidding, where the winning team's contract (Hokm) dictates the trump suit, and the Red and Black Jokers serve as the most powerful permanent trumps.
Developed in the mid-20th century in the Levant and Gulf regions. It is an expansion of the Lebanese game 'Kout', adapted for larger social groups of 6 people.
6 players in two teams of 3. Teammates sit in alternating positions (A1, B1, A2, B2, A3, B3).
Each player receives 9 cards. Dealing and play are counter-clockwise.

items.text: Joker lead only when bid 8 or 9: Joker may be led only if the team bid eight or nine; the rule allowing lead after trump face cards are played is removed.
Joker lead when all trump played: All cards of the trump suit must have been played before a Joker may be led (or team bid 8 or 9).
Kout Bo 4: Four players in two partnerships of two. Stripped deck: remove 5 and below from 52, add two Jokers (rank 6 up plus Jokers). Same deal (9 each), bidding, and scoring as Kout Bo 6.
